# introducer amount

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:introducerAmount`](gmeow-introducerAmount.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/introducerAmount>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/trust`](../../slices/trust.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The trust-signature amount/weight the trustor assigns to the trustee as an introducer.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:TrustAssertion`](../classes/gmeow-TrustAssertion.md) -> [`xsd:integer`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:introducerAmount`](gmeow-introducerAmount.md) from [`gmeow:TrustAssertion`](../classes/gmeow-TrustAssertion.md) to [`xsd:integer`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:TrustAssertion`](../classes/gmeow-TrustAssertion.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the weight a trustor assigns to a trustee as an introducer — the OpenPGP trust-signature amount a projection metric accumulates toward a validity threshold.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for how many introducer levels to follow (that is [`gmeow:introducerDepth`](gmeow-introducerDepth.md)) and avoid using it to compute validity in OWL — it is a declared input weight, not a reasoner-derived score.

### How to use

- Set the amount as [xsd:integer](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer) on the [`gmeow:TrustAssertion`](../classes/gmeow-TrustAssertion.md) alongside [`gmeow:introducerDepth`](gmeow-introducerDepth.md) and [`gmeow:trustLevel`](gmeow-trustLevel.md); the projection-layer metric combines them, leaving the logical core free of trust arithmetic.

### Examples

- ex:t1 [`gmeow:introducerAmount`](gmeow-introducerAmount.md) 120.
